The Ogun State Police Command has arrested three secondary school students aged 12, 18 and 18 over a suspected cult initiation in Owode-Yewa. The state Police Public Relations Officer, Oluseyi Babaseyi, disclosed this in a statement on Friday. According to the PPRO, the suspects were arrested following intelligence about a planned cult activity tagged “Kito Day” involving students from different secondary schools in the area. Babaseyi said the police received the information on October 22, 2026, prompting the Divisional Police Officer in Owode-Yewa to deploy detectives to the scene. He added that the operation was carried out in collaboration with members of the Vigilante Group of Nigeria. The command said the case would be transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department, Eleweran, Abeokuta, for further investigation and possible prosecution. “The case will be transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department (SCID), Eleweran, Abeokuta, today, 23rd October 2026, for further investigation and possible prosecution,” the statement said.
